# Juniper Lantern absence and replacement policy

Effective 1 April 2031. This is a fictional studio document.

For an ordinary absence, notice at least 18 hours before the enrolled class may qualify for one replacement credit. A late notice is sent to the teacher for review; it is not automatically eligible. A credit expires 42 days after the missed class and cannot be exchanged for cash. A replacement requires a live place in an age-appropriate class and a current, unused credit. A class listing does not show live capacity. An unused credit does not itself confirm a replacement booking. An absence already used for a replacement cannot create another credit. Medical or exceptional circumstances require teacher review rather than an automatic policy exception.
